What we need from David

None of this stops design work continuing. All of it needs settling before the new site replaces the existing one.

Promotional offers

The pages carry the financing, warranty and discount terms published on the existing site. Written confirmation is needed before they go live, particularly the financing amount and rate.

Which phone number the new pages use

The existing site uses several numbers, and the one shown most often carries a New York area code. Settling on one number, and how calls are tracked, should happen before launch so call attribution is not lost.

Photography for the outdoor services

The supplied photo library is entirely waterproofing and drainage work. The masonry, paver, patio and retaining wall pages currently run genuine drainage photography, captioned for what it shows. Real photographs of that work are needed.

Two details the existing site states differently in different places

Company ownership is described one way on most pages and another way on a few, and job duration is given as a single day in one place and two to three days in another. Confirming both settles how the new pages read.

Logo file and brand colours

Colours throughout are read from the existing logo and are a placeholder. A clean logo file and the official palette will be applied across every page at once.

Prepared 6 August 2026. Nothing on the existing website has been changed.
